source.note: Portland Maps Public/PPD_Flood_and_Natural_Resources MapServer layer 13 (Columbia Slough Watershed Levee Buffers): the drainage districts' 100 ft levee buffer (BUFF_DIST 100.0002 ft), one dissolved feature covering the levees of the four districts MCDD manages (PEN1, PEN2, MCDD, SDIC; now the Urban Flood Safety and Water Quality District), fetched in EPSG:2913 and rounded to 0.01 ft. The layer says it depicts the 'Levee Review Area' in which MCDD must review development to ensure compliance with federal levee safety standards. Its edge stands 155 to 250 ft from the centre lines of layer 12 (Columbia Slough Levees), so the 100 ft is measured from the levee's toe, not its centre line; the one stretch it leaves out is most of the Denver Ave/I-5 embankment (13.5% covered). Read as a closer look under rulings.yaml 2026-11-28-levee-review-zone-yellow (flats.ingest.quadfit.levee_review_checked).
